description: This file contains implementation of textual diff operations with a focus on pickaxe search functionality. It includes functions for regex-based matching, filtering diff pairs based on patterns, and integrating with the larger diff-processing logic in Git.

classes.name: diffgrep_cb
classes.description: Callback structure for grep pattern matching within diffs.

methods.name: int diffgrep_consume(void * priv,char * line,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Consumes lines during diff output to detect pattern matches.

methods.name: int diff_grep(mmfile_t * one,mmfile_t * two,struct diff_options * o,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs a text diff and returns whether a pattern appears in added/deleted lines.

methods.name: unsigned int contains(mmfile_t * mf,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws,unsigned int limit)
methods.description: Checks if a mmfile contains a pattern or string up to a specified limit.

methods.name: int has_changes(mmfile_t * one,mmfile_t * two,struct diff_options * o UNUSED,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws)
methods.description: Determines if two mmfiles differ with respect to a pattern or string.

methods.name: int pickaxe_match(struct diff_filepair * p,struct diff_options * o,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws,pickaxe_fn fn)
methods.description: Checks if a diff filepair matches the given pattern or criteria.

methods.name: void pickaxe(struct diff_queue_struct * q,struct diff_options * o,regex_t * regexp,kwset_t kws,pickaxe_fn fn)
methods.description: Filters diff queue based on pattern matches using a specified matching function.

methods.name: void regcomp_or_die(regex_t * regex,const char * needle,int cflags)
methods.description: Compiles a regex or terminates on error.

methods.name: void diffcore_pickaxe(struct diff_options * o)
methods.description: Main entry point for performing pickaxe-like diff filtering based on user options.
